Alex L: Quick handoff — I'm handing primary to Priya for the next 8h. There's a low-severity degradation on the embedding path (KV cache miss rate up, 5-15% latency bump). Leaving playbook links and a short cheat-sheet below. If anything pages, Priya primary, Jamal secondary. I'm reachable on DM for 30m.

Priya S: 👍 thanks. can you paste the runbook and current mitigations? any customers impacted?

Alex L: Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-degradation and https://redwood.internal/ops/playbooks/oncall-handbook — short notes:
- Current state: cache miss rate ~12% (baseline 1-2%), embedding latency p95 ~320ms (baseline ~200ms). No errors, just latency.
- Customer impact: few low-volume tenants may see slowed embed responses; no data loss. Tiered customers flagged? none so far.

Alex L: Quick remediations (try in order):
1) Check backlog and drain hotspots:```bash
curl -sS http://infra-metrics/api/queues | jq '.queues["embedding"].backlog'
```
2) Restart the unhealthy cache worker (safe during low traffic):```bash
ssh svc-cache-1 'sudo systemctl restart kv-cache' && sleep 15
curl -sS http://infra-metrics/health | grep cache
```
3) Temporarily enable routing fallback to quantized model for embeddings (low-risk): use Console -> Routing -> manual override OR API:```http
POST /v1/routing/policy
{ "target": "embedding-small-quant", "match": "embedding", "rollout": "manual" }
```
4) If restart fails and latency keeps rising, scale up dedicated cache pool: scale-ops playbook link in runbook.

Maria (SRE): adding health checks to watch:
- metric: model.embedding.latency.p95 > 350ms -> page primary
- metric: cache.miss_rate > 20% -> page primary + secondary
(I'll wire those into alerting before the end of the shift)

incident-bot: ALERT: embedding-p95 spike at 325ms, source=eu-west-1, affected=embedding-route (auto-throttle not triggered)

Priya S: On it. I'll run the backlog check and try a worker restart if we still see high miss rate. Jamal, can you be ready to flip routing if needed?

Jamal R: Copy. I'll stand by to apply routing override and monitor downstream error rates. If routing causes soft-fail rates to increase >0.5% we rollback immediately.

Alex L: One more note — coverage gap: night crew doesn't have a dedicated infra engineer in EU-west between 02:00-04:00 UTC. If escalation goes to infra during that window, use cross-region fallback (roll to us-east) per the fallback-runbook section. I left the recovery token in the runbook page.

Priya S: Ran the checks: backlog=38, miss_rate=13%. Restarting svc-cache-1 now.

Priya S: svc-cache-1 restarted, miss_rate down to 6% after 45s. embedding-p95 back to 220ms. Monitoring for 10m.

Maria (SRE): Nice. I'll keep the alert thresholds aggressive for the next hour. If we see re-regression, escalate to infra and apply routing fallback.

Alex L: Thanks all — handing off done. Priya primary, Jamal secondary. Tagging the runbook checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-degradation#quick-steps :white_check_mark:

Priya S: Taking primary. will update status if anything changes.

Jamal R: Standing by.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — oncall-handoff checklist completed by Alex L at 1917601234

Alex L: leaving this open until my DM window ends, but otherwise good to close the handoff thread.
